description: This file implements a Redis-based grain storage provider for Orleans, handling initialization, reading, writing, and clearing grain state with Redis, including scripting for concurrency control.

classes.name: RedisGrainStorage
classes.description: A class providing Redis-backed storage for Orleans grains, managing lifecycle, state read/write, and cache invalidation with scripting.

methods.name: RedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Redis grain storage with dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage to the silo lifecycle events.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes Redis connection and database, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state from Redis, deserializing data and handling missing or inconsistent data.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes and writes grain state to Redis, using Lua scripting for concurrency control.

methods.name: DefaultGetStorageKey
methods.description: Generates a Redis key for grain storage based on grain type and ID.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or resets grain state in Redis, with optional deletion, handling concurrency conflicts.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and disposes of the Redis connection.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of grain state.

methods.name: LogDebugInitializing
methods.description: Logs debug message for storage initialization.

methods.name: LogDebugInitialized
methods.description: Logs debug message after successful initialization.

methods.name: LogErrorReadStateFailed
methods.description: Logs error during grain state read failure.

methods.name: LogErrorWriteStateFailed
methods.description: Logs error during grain state write failure.
